== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added a "Development and release" section from Players Committee forum posts (refs pcf-…): the March 2005 speculation thread summarising a ''dGamer'' preview, Michael Carr's 11 April 2005 posts, and Doug Taylor's and Brandon Ruck's May 2005 release month.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Release: Doug Taylor (April 2006) gives "#9 - 5/?/05" (May 2005, day unknown); the infobox keeps "by 29 August 2005" (and the first PDF is dated 14 May 2005). Consistent, but the exact day is still missing.
* Carr's "Scott and Doug" are probably [[Scott Lingrell]] and [[Doug Taylor]] (the two Design Advocates in May 2005), but the post gives first names only, so they are not linked.

== 15 July 2005 forum typing, 25 November 2026 ==
A 15 July 2005 typing of the full set texts by CRingwell, in the Players Committee forum topic "Virtual Set 9" (t=6365), was added to [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] from the Internet Archive capture of 18 June 2006 (reached as the next topic from t=6360). The card texts themselves were not copied onto the set page; the capture is cited as a source. This is the pre-2009 set, not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 9]].
